findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_profile_links, import_bio_links, create_shortlink, list_leads · Private data: list_profiles, get_profile_analytics, add_profile_link, update_profile_link, delete_profile_link, import_bio_links, list_leads · Public sink: list_leads · Destructive: get_profile_analytics, list_profile_links, delete_profile_link, list_leads.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_profile_links, import_bio_links, create_shortlink, list_leads · Private data: list_profiles, get_profile_analytics, add_profile_link, update_profile_link, delete_profile_link, import_bio_links, list_leads · Public sink: list_leads · Destructive: get_profile_analytics, list_profile_links, delete_profile_link, list_leads

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
